tips_en: Read WeVisOne-VL first: it offers the clearest technically focused contribution—unifying detection, referring, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting through structured outputs and dense decoding—with unusually broad evaluation. Then read OpenDS-World to see how far multimodal agents can go in autonomous evidence gathering, while IQuest-Q1 provides the complementary systems perspective on scaling robust, long-horizon CLI agents.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读 WeVisOne-VL：它通过结构化输出与密集解码统一检测、指代、计数、OCR、分割和抠图，技术主线最集中，评测覆盖也最广。随后可读 OpenDS-World，了解多模态智能体在自主搜集和整合异构网络证据方面的能力边界；IQuest-Q1 则从训练与系统规模角度补充了构建稳健长程 CLI 智能体的方案。
